svg.title: Spora — identity sheet
svg.desc: Spora logo: 41 seeds placed by golden-angle phyllotaxis inside an organic harmonic envelope, one spore escaping. Warm neutral palette. Full identity sheet: lockups, construction, palette, variations, applications.
svg.text: Grown, not built — a seed head generated by golden-angle phyllotaxis.
Clear space = ¼ mark width · Minimum digital 24 px (small-size mark below 36 px) · Minimum print 18 mm
